race.comment: The feature race and hard to go past the very much in form GRANDAD'S ADICTION (2). Has won two of last three, the latest at Belmont Park over 1650m. Was a winner there over 1700m three back. Looks hard to beat again. SAUCISSON (7) turned things around last start and scored by a nose over 1650m at Belmont Park as well. Looks well placed so expect another big run. ACTA NON VERBA (4) is also coming off a Belmont run when a fast finishing third. First try at the trip but at top and expected to run well. CAPABLE ANGEL (10) was fourth behind GRANDAD'S ADICTION latest and meets him 2.5kg better at the weights. Was favourite in this last year and scored on an pace win and no doubt aimed at the race again. POINT ROCKS (5) is capable of a lot more and gets chance to atone.
